_comment: STRICT tables in live justfit-db. Compared by scripts/smoke.sh against the safety-critical tables the consumer app writes. Regenerate after any migration that adds, drops or rebuilds a table: npx wrangler d1 execute justfit-db --remote --json --command "SELECT name FROM pragma_table_list WHERE schema='main' AND type='table' AND strict=1 ORDER BY name" -- then write the sorted names to "strict". Generated 2026-10-04 from live, with migrations 0119 (cycle_profile, period_log, pregnancy_weekly_log become STRICT) and 0120 (awards, user_awards dropped) applied to the list; until they are applied to D1 the fixture is one step ahead of live.
